description: This file defines the CLIInstaller enum responsible for managing the installation and location detection of the 'openclaw' CLI tool, including methods for installed location, installation process, and parsing installation events.

classes.name: InstallEvent
classes.description: A data structure representing an installation event, decoded from JSON output during installation process.

methods.name: installedLocation
methods.description: Retrieves the location of the installed 'openclaw' binary if present.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Performs installation of the 'openclaw' CLI, updating status via a handler.

methods.name: installPrefix
methods.description: Provides the prefix path where 'openclaw' will be installed.

methods.name: installScriptCommand
methods.description: Constructs the shell command used to download and run the installation script.

methods.name: parseInstallEvents
methods.description: Parses JSON lines from installation command output into InstallEvent structures.

methods.name: shellEscape
methods.description: Escapes a string for safe usage in shell commands.
